title: nightly-labs/openbot: a local desktop for Codex, Claude, and Grok
friendlyTitle: nightly-labs/openbot: a desktop app for Codex, Claude, and Grok on your own computer
summary: OpenBot is a desktop app for persistent AI teammates, with separate workspaces, a task queue, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent handoff. It runs Codex, Claude, and Grok locally rather than as a hosted chat. On GitHub's daily trending list it gained 794 stars, to 2,264. It is not an OpenAI project.
friendlySummary: OpenBot is a desktop app for AI teammates that stay on your machine. Each one can have its own workspace. It includes a task queue, file sharing, browser control, and a way for agents to hand work to each other. It runs Codex, Claude, and Grok locally, rather than as a hosted chat. On GitHub's daily trending list it gained 794 stars. The repo now has 2,264. It is not an OpenAI project.
whyItMatters: Use it when you want more than one agent on the same machine, with a queue and a shared folder, without sending the workspace to a vendor's cloud. The current license is PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Commercial use needs a separate license from the copyright owner. Versions through 0.1.11 remain Apache-2.0.
